title: Linguistics and the Study of Literature
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a force to reckon with as it deals with how stretches of language, considered in their full textual, social and physiological context, become meaningful and unified for their users."
Cohesion is a force to reckon with as it deals with how stretches of language, considered in their full textual, social and physiological context, become meaningful and unified for their users.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability not only to produce sentences correctly, but also produce them in an interactionally appropriate way."
Communicative competence is the ability not only to produce sentences correctly, but also produce them in an interactionally appropriate way.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of mutually relevant communicative functions, structured in such a way as to achieve an overall rhetorical purpose."
Text is a set of mutually relevant communicative functions, structured in such a way as to achieve an overall rhetorical purpose.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a general term used in linguistics to refer to specific parts of an utterance or text) near or adjacent to a unit which is the focus of attention."
Context is a general term used in linguistics to refer to specific parts of an utterance or text) near or adjacent to a unit which is the focus of attention.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a sub-class of cultural forms involving participants or actors."
Social roles like linguistic forms are a sub-class of cultural forms involving participants or actors.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to possibilities subordinated to structure; Halliday "liberated" choice from structure and made it the central organising dimension of SFL."
Firth proposed that systems refer to possibilities subordinated to structure; Halliday "liberated" choice from structure and made it the central organising dimension of SFL.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition where sentences in a text hang together."
Coherency is a condition where sentences in a text hang together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up of NP with the structure: The + noun + of + your + noun."
The four lines are made up of NP with the structure: The + noun + of + your + noun.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a semantic properties of discourse formed through the interpretation of other sentences, with "interpretation" implying interaction between the text and the reader."
Coherence is a semantic properties of discourse formed through the interpretation of other sentences, with "interpretation" implying interaction between the text and the reader.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by Ohmann (1959) in his argument that all utterances are to be understood as instances of purposeful human actions which happen to require language for their expression."

Austin and Searle's Speech Act is used by Ohmann (1959) in his argument that all utterances are to be understood as instances of purposeful human actions which happen to require language for their expression.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols or signs."
Language can be defined as a systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols or signs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to unite those lines as a single entity."
The marks are used to unite those lines as a single entity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described by Kreidler (1989, pp.5-6) as a study of language concerned with the way speech sounds are organized into a system of a given language."
Phonology is described by Kreidler (1989, pp.5-6) as a study of language concerned with the way speech sounds are organized into a system of a given language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an art that involves crafting with language."
Literature is an art that involves crafting with language.

mode of discourse

spoken language
